ANNEX 6: The Recapitalization and strengthening of NBL and RBB

1. The recapitalization plans of the two state-controlled banks are phased and have

been proceeding mostly according to plan, indicating the seriousness of the

government of Nepal and the NRB in addressing the vulnerabilities of the

financial sector and, in particular, those of the two state-controlled banks. 32 The
